name: PeMS04
description: A traffic forecasting benchmark built from California Department of Transportation Performance Measurement System (PeMS) data. PeMS04 contains traffic-flow observations from 307 sensors in the San Francisco Bay Area, aggregated into 5-minute intervals over January through February 2018. This record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Song, C., Lin, Y., Guo, S., & Wan, H. (2020). Spatial-Temporal Synchronous Graph Convolutional Networks: A New Framework for Spatial-Temporal Network Data Forecasting. Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence, 34(1), 914–921. https://doi.org/10.1609/aaai.v34i01.5438
